trigger_cases.prompt: Audit these Python sdist and wheel files before I publish them to PyPI.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests the exact pre-publication artifact consistency audit owned by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Is this package and GitHub Actions Trusted Publishing workflow ready for a PyPI release?
trigger_cases.rationale: Combines local distribution inspection with the bounded publishing-workflow preflight.

trigger_cases.prompt: Check that pyproject.toml, PKG-INFO, wheel METADATA, and filenames agree on name and version.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names the identity-consistency gates performed by the deterministic checker.

trigger_cases.prompt: Upload this wheel to PyPI and publish version 2.0.0.
trigger_cases.rationale: Publishing is a network-writing task and is explicitly outside this read-only audit.

trigger_cases.prompt: Create a new Python package and choose its project structure.
trigger_cases.rationale: Package creation is a different user goal with no existing release artifacts to audit.

trigger_cases.prompt: Verify that this already-published GitHub Release has the right assets and tag.
trigger_cases.rationale: Post-publication GitHub Release evidence belongs to audit-github-release.

trigger_cases.prompt: Fix the failing unit tests in my Python repository.
trigger_cases.rationale: General test remediation changes code and is unrelated to distribution readiness.
